title: On a phone, a long date range on a dashboard tile never makes the page scroll sideways
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin with the Reports permission.
The browser is phone-sized (about 390 x 844 pixels).
Browser storage holds no remembered tile date ranges.

custom_steps_separated.expected: The tiles stand in one column, each within the screen width, and the page does not scroll sideways.

custom_steps_separated.content: On a tile with a long name (Technician Utilization), open the date pill, click "Today", then "Apply".
custom_steps_separated.expected: The pill shows the full date range (e.g. "Oct 13, 2026 - Oct 13, 2026"). When it does not fit beside the tile name it moves onto its own line under the name; it stays inside the tile.

custom_steps_separated.content: Set "Today" the same way on the Revenue tile and try to drag the page left and right.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The page does not scroll sideways; every tile is still no wider than the screen.

custom_steps_separated.content: Change the Technician Utilization tile back to "This Month".
custom_steps_separated.expected: The pill shows "This Month" on the same line as the tile name, and the page still does not scroll sideways.
